t: When you cannot say it to anyone else
a: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
p: …innamā ashkū baththī wa ḥuznī ila-llāhi wa aʿlamu mina-llāhi mā lā taʿlamūn.
m: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
